title: Module review
subtitle: Everything about Tannat
objectives: Know its homes in France and Uruguay
Explain how it is softened and served

steps.explanation: Skins and seeds carry tannin, and Tannat has plenty of both.

steps.prompt: Match each fact to Tannat's story.
Basque immigrants brought Tannat to Uruguay.

steps.explanation: Cold makes tannin feel harder, not softer.

steps.prompt: Madiran must contain at least ____% Tannat.
steps.explanation: At least 60%, often blended with Cabernet Franc.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Tannat is dark, highly tannic and acidic
Madiran is its French home; Uruguay its adopted one
Micro-oxygenation, oak and blending soften it
It's the wine for grilled meat and duck
